title: Etale compatibility of the normal integration factor
statement: For the etale correspondence and normalized charts C and E, let m be the ordinary coefficient-twist transport conjugated by the two open/site restriction comparisons. Let n be the actual normal transport through the common source diagonal. Then m followed by vO*(twistToNormal E) equals jO*(twistToNormal C) followed by n. No delta, alpha, rho, compact-support normalization or dualizing comparison occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Replace the supplied ordinary finite twist transport by the canonical purity transport, using uniqueness of the normalized roots and pure-tensor maps. Infer that jO and vO are etale and separated by cancelling the open inclusions. Set h=jO followed by f restricted to V; cancel the monic inclusion of V to identify vO followed by g restricted to V with h.

Use normalGeometry for each arrow to obtain the actual zero-preserving Cartesian normal-bundle square. Choose the supplied vector models for C and E and the symmetric-algebra normal model for the diagonal of h. On this last model form betaO from inverse integration and the identity-base section comparison. Its inverse followed by the model comparison is exactly vectorBetaInverse.

Apply the proved model_beta_compat helper of DiagonalOrientationCompatibility to each Cartesian normal square, the chosen target model, the common source model and the chart normalization. This helper pastes section base-change composition with vector_zero_section_integration_baseChange, then cancels the integration isomorphism. It yields jO*(betaC) followed by Tate(jO) = section(jO) followed by betaO, and the analogous equation for vO. No new compatibility hypothesis or unproved lemma is introduced.

Apply naturality of the canonical derived site comparison to the two ordinary beta equations. After unfolding the specified normal comparison, cancel the common normal-site comparison. Invert each equation to express the pulled-back twistToNormal as the composed Tate restriction, inverse common betaO, and the respective actual normal comparison.

Prove composition of the pro-etale Tate comparison from pullComparison_comp and orderedTateCoefficientComposition. Apply composition to the two factorizations k followed by the target open and the source open followed by j (or v), with their given equality. The resulting equations identify their outer comparison with restrictionAlong. Paste the j and v equations, cancel the inverse v coefficient comparison, then cancel the common betaO and the common-source normal comparison. The remaining equality is exactly the stated beta square. All steps use isomorphism and functor identities uniformly in dimension zero and on empty opens.

theorem diagonalDncEtaleNaturality_beta (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification g]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens)
    (C : OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V)
    (E : OrientationRefinement.Chart P g aY d V)
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian U]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [Etale j] [IsSeparated j] [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (v : U ⟶ Z) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [LocallyOfFiniteType v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (w : v ≫ g = j ≫ f)
    [HasCompactification (j ≫ f)] [HasCompactification (v ≫ g)]
    (O : U.Opens) (jO : O.toScheme ⟶ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (vO : O.toScheme ⟶ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).toScheme)
    (hj : jO ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ j)
    (hv : vO ≫ (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι = O.ι ≫ v) :
    let νU := (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) U).mapDerivedCategory
    let T := OrientationRefinement.pull P O.ι
    let cj := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P j (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O jO hj
    let cv := OrientationCounit.restrictionAlong P v (g ⁻¹ᵁ V.1) O vO hv
    let a :=
      (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t j (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (f ≫ aY)) d).hom ≫
      (Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t v (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit (g ≫ aY)) d).inv
    let m := (cj.app (P.diagonalTwistEtale X d)).hom ≫
      T.map (νU.map a) ≫
      (cv.app (P.diagonalTwistEtale Z d)).inv
    let n := DiagonalEtaleComparison.normalTransport P d f g aY V C.geometry E.geometry U j v w
      O jO vO hj hv
    m ≫ (OrientationRefinement.pull P vO).map
        (DiagonalEtaleComparison.twistToNormal P d g aY V E).hom =
      (OrientationRefinement.pull P jO).map
        (DiagonalEtaleComparison.twistToNormal P d f aY V C).hom ≫ n.hom
